title: A Mathematical Theory of Communication: original July 1948 part
version: Bell System Technical Journal 27(3), July 1948, pp. 379–423
lineage: Internet Archive scan of the original printed July 1948 article; distinguished from the corrected reprint already registered. Header and section 17 inspected, with the latter visually checked.

passages.locator: Printed pp. 379 and 418; PDF pp. 1 and 40
passages.note: The original July 1948 issue header is on printed page 379. Section 17, printed page 418, presents a seven-symbol error-correcting example and explicitly attributes its method to R. Hamming. The example therefore appears in the original issue, not only in the later corrected reprint. This does not establish the date of Hamming’s private work or all constructions in his 1950 paper.
